title: CivBench: Progress-Based Evaluation for LLMs' Strategic Decision-Making in Civilization V
abstract: arXiv:2604.07733v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating strategic decision-making in LLM-based agents requires generative, competitive, and longitudinal environments, yet few benchmarks provide all three, and fewer still offer evaluation signals rich enough for long-horizon, multi-agent play. We introduce CivBench, a benchmark for LLM strategists (a model under an agentic setup) in multiplayer Civilization V. Because terminal win/loss is too sparse a signal in games spanning hundreds of turns and multiple opponents, CivBench trains estimators of a state-value function, the probability that a player eventually wins given the game state. cross 307 games with 7 LLMs and multiple CivBench agent conditions, we demonstrate CivBench's potential to estimate strategic capabilities in Civilization V as an unsaturated benchmark, reveal model-specific effects of agentic setup, and outline distinct strategic profiles not visible through outcome-only evaluation.

translated_title: CivBench：基于进程的《文明V》中大语言模型战略决策评估
translated_abstract: 评估基于大语言模型的智能体的战略决策能力需要生成性、竞争性和纵向的环境，然而很少有基准测试能同时提供这三者，能提供足够丰富的评估信号以支持长时程、多智能体对局的基准测试更是少之又少。我们提出了CivBench，一个面向《文明V》多人游戏中大语言模型战略家（即在智能体设置下运行的模型）的基准测试。由于在跨越数百回合、涉及多个对手的游戏中，最终的胜负结果作为评估信号过于稀疏，CivBench训练了状态价值函数的估计器，即在给定游戏状态的情况下预测玩家最终获胜的概率。通过在307场对局中测试7个大语言模型和多种CivBench智能体条件，我们展示了CivBench作为一个尚未饱和的基准测试在评估《文明V》战略能力方面的潜力，揭示了智能体设置对不同模型的特定影响，并勾勒出仅凭结果评估无法发现的独特战略特征。
tldr: CivBench是一个基于《文明V》多人游戏的大语言模型战略决策评估基准，通过训练状态价值函数估计器（预测玩家最终获胜概率）来提供比稀疏胜负信号更丰富的评估，揭示了各模型的独特战略特征和智能体设置的影响。
en_tdlr: CivBench is a benchmark for evaluating LLM strategic decision-making in multiplayer Civilization V that trains state-value function estimators (predicting eventual win probability) to provide richer evaluation signals than sparse win/loss outcomes, revealing model-specific strategic profiles and agentic setup effects.
